About the Program
Gain advanced training in the interdisciplinary application of methods, paradigms, technologies, and devices from engineering and the natural sciences to problems in biology, medicine, and the life sciences in our BBME PhD program.
About the Program
Who Can Apply
The BBME PhD Program prides itself on the diversity of the students – hailing from all areas of engineering and from the physical, chemical and life sciences and medicine – who choose to pursue graduate degrees with us. Find out more about our requirements.
